description.value: Mogu Fried Chicken is a 34-seat izakaya-style Japanese fried chicken restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, opened by Yuji and Kumiko Aoki after seven years operating the Mogu food truck at Howe and Dunsmuir. The restaurant is known for its umami-rich boneless fried chicken paired with an extensive selection of Japanese draft beers, sake flights, whisky, and house cocktails. Both dine-in and takeout are offered, including family- and party-sized fried chicken packs.
